place_name_en: M50 Creative Park / M50 Art District

sources.title: 50 Moganshan Road Art Gallery, Art Museum in Shanghai
sources.content:
"There's a thriving artists' quarter on the banks of the Suzhou Creek" at 50 Moganshan Road, known as Shanghai M50 Art Community. This former textile mill has been converted into a vibrant creative hub featuring galleries, studios, art spaces, cafes, and restaurants showcasing contemporary and emerging Chinese artists.

The complex hosts approximately 100 promising artists and several renowned modern artists. Notable figures include Ding Yi, Zhou Tiehai, and Xu Zhen. The artistic output spans diverse media: "paintings of every description, sculpture using a wide variety of materials, photographs, textiles and experimental work."

Three significant galleries operate at the location:
- ShanghArt Gallery (Buildings 16 & 18): Listed by Thames & Hudson as one of the world's top 75 influential galleries, representing about 40 primarily Chinese artists
- Eastlink Gallery (5th floor, Building 6): Occupies 900 square meters, promoting both foreign and local art
- ArtScene: Another major exhibition space

The site was originally "Factory, office, and warehouse space of Shangtex, a state-owned textile company," which closed in 1999. In 2000, contemporary artist Xue Song moved in due to affordable rental rates, attracting other artists. The community developed organically as galleries and design firms subsequently leased space.

Visitor Information:
- Address: 50 Moganshan Road (莫干山路50号), Jingan District
- Hours: Most galleries open 10am to 7pm
- Daily visitors: Approximately 400, predominantly international tourists
- Art purchases: Range from a few dollars to significant collector's items

Visitors can "wander through the sometimes chaotic area and in and out of working studios and display spaces." The location offers "an interesting contrast from the more traditional aspects of China" and provides opportunities to meet artists and engage with contemporary Chinese art culture.

sources.title: Shanghai M50 Art District: Galleries, Studios & Travel Tips
sources.content:
Fast Facts: Location: No. 50 Moganshan Road, Putuo District, Shanghai. Operating daily 8 AM–10 PM (closed Mondays). Free entry. Visit duration: 2–3 hours. Best time: weekdays 2–5 PM during autumn season.

Historical Background: Originally the Xinhe Yarn Factory (established 1930s), this textile manufacturing hub became the Chunming Spinning Factory by 1994. Following industrial restructuring in 1999, the 100,000-square-meter complex with 50+ factory buildings closed. Artist Xue Song led the first group of creatives to occupy the space in 2000, attracted by affordable rents and distinctive industrial architecture.

Artistic Character: "M50 weaves art into daily life, exuding a more relaxed atmosphere" than refined art districts. Over 100 artists and designers now work here. Unlike Beijing's 798 Art District (government-developed, more commercialized), M50 organically formed with greater artistic authenticity. The riverside location features intersecting alleyways creating intimate spaces.

Art Forms Present:
- Painting: Abstract oil, watercolor, acrylic, experimental works
- Sculpture: Recycled materials including repurposed textile machinery
- Photography: Documentary, conceptual, digital focusing on urban/social change
- Additional: Installation, multimedia, graffiti, performance, sound, mixed media

Major Galleries: ShanghArt Gallery (established 1996), Yibo Gallery (1998, 100+ exhibitions), Eastlink Gallery (October 1999), Polar Bear Gallery (2011), H Gallery.

Visitor Activities: Explore 46 galleries, photograph graffiti walls and industrial buildings, visit cafés (Shuita Café, LINsCafe), shop craft stores, participate in DIY workshops (pottery, painting, accessories).

Transportation: Metro Line 13 to Jiangning Road (10-minute walk); Line 1 to Shanghai Railway Station (17-minute walk); Bus 64 to Changhua-Macau Road (8-minute walk); taxi from Bund (~25–30 minutes, 20–30 RMB).

Local Tips: Wear bright clothing for contrast in photos. Allow 3 hours. Visit 2–5 PM weekdays for fewer crowds. Check social media for special exhibitions. Respect no-photography signs. Budget 1,000+ RMB for original artworks; less for merchandise.

sources.title: Shanghai M50 Creative Park Visitor Guide Location Hours and Ticket Info
sources.content:
M50 Creative Park is situated at 50 Moganshan Road in Putuo District, positioned along Suzhou Creek in Shanghai's heart. The venue occupies converted industrial warehouse spaces that formerly housed factories.

Operating Hours: Daily Hours: 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Closed: Mondays. Gallery Hours: Most galleries operate 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Admission & Tickets: Entry Fee: Completely free for all visitors. No tickets required to access the park itself. Some special exhibitions may charge separate fees. Most galleries remain free to explore.

Transportation Options:
Metro Lines: Line 13: Exit at Jiangning Road, walk 8 minutes east. Line 1: Exit at Railway Station (South Square), walk 8 minutes west. Lines 3/4: Exit at Shanghai Railway Station (North Square), walk 10 minutes west.
Buses: Routes 41, 58, 185, 332, 510, 741, 845, 966.
Alternative Transport: Taxis available via Alipay; starting fare approximately ¥14. Didi ride-sharing app recommended for convenience. Avoid rush hours (7:30-9:30 AM, 4:30-6:30 PM).

Best Visiting Times: Optimal visit window: 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM. Weekdays offer fewer crowds. Soft afternoon light ideal for photography. Recommended duration: 2-3 hours.

What to Experience: Galleries & Studios: Over 140 galleries and artist studios. Artists from 20+ countries represented. Island 6 Art Gallery, ShanghArt, and numerous contemporary art spaces. Watch active artists in functioning studios.

Amenities: Clean restrooms throughout. Cafes and snack shops available. Free Wi-Fi in select areas. Resting areas along Suzhou Creek.

Visitor Demographics: Annual visitors: Over 300,000. Typical age group: 20-30 years (55%). Group composition: Primarily small groups (64%). International visitors: 22% of total.

Additional Tips: Maps provided at entrance assist navigation. Photography generally permitted; always confirm with staff. Guided tours available for enhanced experiences. Wheelchair and stroller accessibility available, though some spaces may be tight. Check for special events requiring advance booking.

sources.title: M50 Creative Park, Shanghai M50 Art District
sources.content:
Situated on the south bank of Suzhou River in Shanghai's Putuo District, "M50 was considered as the cradle of Shanghai's contemporary art scene." The address is Lane No.50, Moganshan Road, Putuo District, Shanghai.

Hours & Admission: Operating from 10:00 – 18:00 daily. Entry is completely free.

About the Space: Formerly dilapidated warehouses, the complex transformed from Shanghai Chunming Textile Factory since 2000. "The buildings owned by M50 are more than 50 industrial buildings from various historical periods from the 1930s to the 1990s."

Artists & Creative Community: The district hosts "more than 140 artists, filmmakers, architects and graphic design firms." Notable galleries include Shangh ART, operated by Swiss native Lorenz Helbling in Building 16.

Features: "The main features are graffiti along the street and free gallery exhibitions, which can be seen in abstract, watercolor, oil painting and other works."

Activities: Photography and vlogging opportunities. Purchase original artworks. Exercise along adjacent Suzhou River path. Visit cafes like Bandu Music Café. Browse fashion shops by young designers.

M50 Art Season: Running July through September, featuring "64 galleries and art institutions, along with 117 artists" hosting "over 137 exhibitions."

Visiting Time: 2-3 hours recommended.

sources.title: M50 Creative Park Travel Guide & Travel Experiences 2026
sources.content:
M50 Creative Park, located in the Putuo section of the Suzhou Creek in Shanghai, is a landmark that was transformed from an abandoned textile factory into a thriving art district. It is often compared with New York's SoHo and Beijing's 798 Art Zone.

It has transformed into a vibrant art district with more than 140 galleries, studios, and design spaces from over 20 countries. M50 has a uniquely European, Bohemian vibe, with small independent coffee shops, hipster art stores and graffiti littered all over the walls.

Notable Galleries & Attractions:
- ShanghART Gallery – One of China's leading contemporary art galleries, showcasing major Chinese and international artists.
- Island6 Arts Center – Known for its creative use of LED art and digital installations.
- There is also pottery making, silver jewelry making, bamboo art learning, oil painting and many other hands-on experiences.

Best Time to Visit: The best season to visit the M50 throughout the year is autumn. You can choose to visit the park on weekdays from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Since there are fewer visitors on weekdays, and most galleries are open from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM, arriving after 2:00 PM allows you to fully explore the galleries and get good lighting for photography.

General Tips: You'll be doing a lot of walking. Most galleries open around 11 am. Some may have shorter hours on Mondays. Many artists have open studios where you can see works-in-progress and even chat with them. In addition to the art space, there are many interesting shops, bars, and cafés.

Getting There: Take Metro Line 13 and get off at Jiangning Road. Get out from Exit 1. Walk east for 8 minutes.

sources.title: M50创意园_百度百科
sources.content:
M50创意园位于上海市普陀区莫干山路50号，占地面积34.45亩，建筑面积约4.1万平方米。

历史背景：前身为上海春明粗纺厂，原为近代徽商周氏家族企业——信和纱厂。解放后更名为上海第十二毛纺织厂、上海春明粗纺厂。1999年停止原主业生产，2000年起转型为艺术创意园区。

建筑特色：园区保留了自上世纪30年代至90年代各历史时期的工业建筑约4.1万平方米，是苏州河沿岸保存较为完整的民族纺织工业遗址之一。标志性景观包括莫干山路涂鸦墙等。

入驻机构：引进了来自20个国家和地区的140余户艺术家工作室、画廊及文化创意机构，包括香格纳画廊、华府艺术、上海大学美术学院等。

重要活动：自2005年起举办上海国际服装文化节、时装周、CREATIVEM50年度创意新锐评选等活动。2008年制作话剧《浮生计》，公开演出近30场。2016年举办M50艺术季，包含137个展览。

荣誉认可：2007年被国家旅游局批准为全国工业旅游示范点。

开放时间：全年08:00-22:00。门票：免费。建议游玩时长：3小时。景点级别：AAA级。

交通指南：可乘坐地铁一号线、三号线、四号线到上海火车站下，或地铁十三号线江宁路站下车。也可乘坐多条公交线路到达。

sources.title: 扫楼攻略：上海M50创意园 - 知乎
sources.content:
M50创意园位于苏州河南岸半岛地带的莫干山路50号，占地面积约41亩，建筑面积41606平方米，拥有自上世纪30年代至90年代各个历史时期的工业建筑50余幢，是苏州河畔保留最为完整的民族工业建筑遗存。

园区已引进20个国家和地区的140余户艺术家工作室、画廊及文化创意机构。最大的特色是沿街的涂鸦和免费的画廊展览，可以看到抽象的、水彩的、油画的等各种画家的作品。

园内有许多有趣的商铺、酒吧和咖啡馆。如果逛累了，可以找一家茶室品尝各类茶香，或者找一家甜品店品尝手工小点心。还有许多创新手工体验店，如陶艺、银饰制作、竹编艺术学习、油画等。
